capability_findings.observed: spi_master_controller instantiates only spi_master_clkgen, spi_master_tx and spi_master_rx; spi_master_fifo is not reachable from this top. The locked file list also contains spi_master_fifo.sv (src_files.yml:7), but adding it to the command line neither adds a module instance nor changes the warning count (5 in both cases), so the minimal closure for this top is 4 files.

This top is the reusable SPI engine core: raw control inputs (spi_clk_div/valid, spi_rd/wr/qrd/qwr, spi_cmd, spi_addr, lengths, dummy counts, csreg), a 7-bit state output spi_status, an eot pulse, and the SPI pins. It contains no APB slave interface and no FIFO - those live in pulp_spi's apb_spi_master.

Single-line mode drives MOSI on spi_sdo0 with the MSB first (tx: `assign sdo0 = en_quad_in ? data_int[28] : data_int[31];` shift `{data_int[30:0],1'b0}`) and samples MISO on spi_sdi1 (rx: `{data_int[30:0],sdi1}`). spi_sdi0 is the MOSI-side loopback pin; sdi2/sdi3 and sdo1..3 are only used in quad modes where sdo0..3 carry data_int[28..31].

SCK comes from spi_master_clkgen: toggles every clk_div+1 HCLK cycles, resets/idles low, stops only while low when en=0; spi_rise marks the 0->1 toggle and spi_fall the 1->0 toggle. The controller wires tx_edge=spi_fall and rx_edge=spi_rise, i.e. CPOL=0/CPHA=0 (SPI mode 0) with the leading rising edge as the sampling edge.

Timing is hardwired to mode 0; no CPOL/CPHA/polarity/phase port or register exists in the repo. spi_mode reports the line width only: SPI_STD=2'b00, SPI_QUAD_TX=2'b01, SPI_QUAD_RX=2'b10, latched into the spi_mode register on every clock.

spi_csn[i] = ~spi_csreg[i] | spi_cs with spi_cs held 0 for the whole transfer and 1 only in IDLE, so all selected CS lines assert together at transfer start and release at end-of-transfer; csreg is not decoded, so multiple CS can assert simultaneously and per-byte CS framing is impossible.
Declared as an input but never referenced (`//FIXME Not used at all`); the only occurrence in the file is the port declaration, so this top has no working software reset.
do_tx is declared `//FIXME NOT USED at all!!` and is only ever assigned (in reset and in the state register block); it is never read, so it has no effect on behaviour.

The FSM enum includes MODE and a MODE case arm exists, but no assignment `state_next = MODE` occurs anywhere, so the MODE state is unreachable and its status bit spi_status[3] can never assert. The reachable states are IDLE, CMD, ADDR, DUMMY, DATA_TX, DATA_RX and WAIT_EDGE.
eot is a registered-decoded one-cycle pulse asserted when the FSM leaves DUMMY, DATA_TX or WAIT_EDGE back to IDLE; it is a pulse, not a level, and lasts exactly one HCLK cycle.

spi_status is a one-hot state indicator: bit0 IDLE, bit1 CMD, bit2 ADDR, bit3 MODE (unreachable), bit4 DUMMY, bit5 DATA_TX, bit6 DATA_RX; FIFO occupancy is not part of this word (it is combined with the FIFO counts inside apb_spi_master).
Single clock, asynchronous active-low reset on posedge clk/negedge rstn for the FSM, counters and mode register; no CDC and no gated-clock input.

Verilator elaborates spi_master_controller from 4 files (5 module instances) with exit 0 and 5 warnings (3x WIDTHEXPAND at controller:222/232/301, 2x CASEINCOMPLETE at controller:156/209). Dropping any of the four files fails (MODMISSING or top-module-not-found) and re-running in a tree containing only those files reproduces exit 0 with the same count.

unsupported.reason: This top has no APB slave ports; APB register semantics are only available through pulp_spi (spi_master_apb_if + apb_spi_master).
spi_swrst is declared but unused, so this top cannot be reset from software; only its consumers can clear their own state.
The MODE state is unreachable, so spi_status[3] is a permanent zero and cannot be used as a state indication.
CPOL/CPHA are hardwired to mode 0 via tx_edge=spi_fall / rx_edge=spi_rise; no mode selection exists.
spi_master_fifo.sv is listed in the upstream src_files.yml but is not reachable from this top; FIFO behaviour must be elaborated under pulp_spi (or with spi_master_fifo as its own top), not here.
